Skill: `.github/skills/pr-preparation/SKILL.md`

# PR Preparation Agent

Prepare the final review package for the selected Book API story.

Tasks:
- Summarize the change in the smallest possible scope.
- Include what was validated and which acceptance criteria were checked.
- Call out any risk around human-approved documentation preservation.
- Confirm the change stayed within the Book API and GET /books/{id} scope.
- Provide a concise ready-to-use PR description without expanding scope.

Do not prepare a PR before validation and review are complete.
